name: Friend of the Kirin Tor
summary: Archmage Modera's image admits that the council will dislike hearing of the subterfuge, yet cannot argue with results: Dalaran is calming, and the wards may come down. She gives you an arcane mote to take to Archmage Celindra, in the Violet Citadel.

sections.title: The Good Word
sections.body: The Image of Archmage Modera admits that the council will dislike hearing of the subterfuge, yet cannot argue with results. The city is calming, and the wards may now be lowered. She thinks you should be the one to carry the good word, and gives you an arcane mote to take to Archmage Celindra, in Dalaran's Violet Citadel.

faq.q: Who sends you to Archmage Celindra?
aliases: who gives friend of the kirin tor
friend of the kirin tor quest giver
faq.answer: The Image of Archmage Modera, who has you deliver the good word about Dalaran.

aliases: where to turn in friend of the kirin tor
faq.answer: In the Violet Citadel, in the City of Dalaran.

faq.q: What item do you carry to the Violet Citadel?
aliases: friend of the kirin tor item
faq.answer: An arcane mote, which Modera gives you to take to Archmage Celindra.
That Dalaran is calming down and its wards are free to be lowered.
